paper_title: Interaction-Structured Motion Retargeting for Multi-Party Humanoid–Object Interactions
manuscript: Draft v6.2 was checked outside this tree. Table I matches evaluation/join/postprocess_metrics.csv. Fig. 2 and the source half of Fig. 4 are not bundled.

join.setting: Six CORE4D-Real clips, action join, obstacle box, obs0: 20231108/018,019,020,108,109,110. Two Unitree G1 29-DoF robots. Object pose is an input.

methods.name: Independent IK
methods.role: Historical per-person IK and the J0 ablation. Not the strong baseline.

methods.name: Frozen v41
methods.role: Visually accepted Join reference. J4 component stack, warm-started. Not EXT-JC. Inter-robot clearance term is inactive on these takes.

methods.name: OA-Independent
methods.role: Strong independent baseline. Same J4 objective and budget as v41, one robot at a time.

methods.name: Separable contact surrogate
methods.role: Same as EXT-JC except the product s1*s2 is replaced by (s1+s2)/2, weight 10, then the same smoothing repair as F.

methods.name: EXT-JC w10 unrepaired
methods.role: J4 plus L_JC = mean_t (1 - s1*s2) on source joint-carry frames, weight 10. Not the final visual result.

methods.name: EXT-JC w10 + smoothing repair
methods.role: Final coupled Join method. E, then the frozen clearance smoothing recipe, then ext_jc_postprocess.py. The loss is not changed.

join.final_numbers: evaluation/join/postprocess_metrics.csv rows ext_repaired. Do not replace them with the unrepaired n=5 row in paper_ready_results_table.csv.

soccer.setting: One 144-frame, 24 fps sequence. Two independent G1 solves. Ball synthesized after IK.
soccer.method: Frozen Full: event-conditioned independent Adam IK (accepted run: 340 iterations, lr 0.04) plus post-IK snap_ball_to_g1_feet.
soccer.reproduction_limit: The current retarget_dual_g1_soccer.py default is 260 iterations and its stationing code has changed since 2026-10-01. Rerunning it does not reproduce the frozen NPZ.
